channel.title: Wyatt's Notes — C++
channel.description: C++ programming from fundamentals to advanced template metaprogramming.

item.title: Thread Execution (std::jthread) and Hardware Mapping
item.description: Thread creation with std::jthread, hardware concurrency detection, join/detach semantics, RAII-based thread guards, and cooperative cancellation patterns.

item.title: Data Races and Race Conditions
item.description: Understanding data races in concurrent C++ programs, race condition examples, and techniques for detecting and preventing concurrent access bugs.

item.title: Mutexes and Deadlocks
item.description: std::mutex, std::lock_guard, std::unique_lock, deadlock prevention strategies, and lock ordering techniques for thread-safe C++ code.

item.title: Condition Variables
item.description: std::condition_variable for thread synchronization, producer-consumer patterns, spurious wakeups, and proper usage with predicates.

item.title: Thread-Local Storage
item.description: Thread-local storage with thread_local keyword, initialization patterns, and use cases for thread-specific data in concurrent C++ programs.

item.title: Instruction Reordering
item.description: How compilers and CPUs reorder instructions, memory barriers, and the C++ memory model's guarantees for concurrent access.

item.title: Cache Coherency
item.description: CPU cache coherency protocols, false sharing, and performance implications for concurrent C++ applications running on multi-core systems.

item.title: Atomic Operations
item.description: std::atomic types, atomic operations, compare-and-swap (CAS), and lock-free programming techniques in modern C++.

item.title: Memory Orderings
item.description: C++ memory orderings: relaxed, acquire, release, sequential consistency. Choosing the right memory ordering for performance and correctness.

item.title: CAS Loops
item.description: Compare-and-swap loop patterns for lock-free data structures, ABA problem, and practical implementations in C++.

item.title: Coroutine Frames and Promise Types
item.description: C++20 coroutine implementation details: coroutine frames, promise types, initial and final suspend points, and coroutine_handle operations.

item.title: Filesystem Library
item.description: std::filesystem for directory traversal, file operations, path manipulation, and filesystem error handling in modern C++.

item.title: Chrono Library
item.description: std::chrono for time duration measurement, clock types, time points, and duration arithmetic in modern C++.

item.title: C++ Programming — Complete Guide
item.description: 130 pages of C++ programming notes covering concurrency, standard library, template metaprogramming, and advanced language features.
